name: Jamnalal Bajaj Institute of Management Studies (JBIMS), University of Mumbai

programs.name: Master of Management Studies (MMS) - Two Year Full-Time Degree Programme
programs.feeNote: Only the first-year fee is published: total fee for A.Y. 2026-27 (first year, 2026-28 batch) is INR 4,34,289 for Open / J&K Migrant category (ST/SC INR 10,000; OBC/EWS/SEBC female INR 2,63,664, male INR 3,48,977; VJ/DT-NT/SBC/Orphan INR 2,63,664; TFWS INR 2,68,914), plus eligibility-cum-enrolment fee of INR 0-3,000 depending on university of graduation. Second-year fee not published, so two-year total left null. Hostel not included.
programs.intakeNote: NIRF 2026 data submitted by JBIMS (hosted on jbims.edu): sanctioned intake 190 for all 2-year PG programmes combined (A.Y. 2024-25). The MMS course page states an MMS intake of 150-160 students; the 2024-26 MMS batch strength was 155.
programs.placementNote: MMS only, from the Unified Final Placement Report 2024-26: batch strength 155; mean CTC INR 26.67 LPA, median INR 26.15 LPA, highest INR 80 LPA, top 10% avg INR 38.25 LPA, top 30% avg INR 33.37 LPA; 70+ recruiters, 93 PPOs/PPIs. No audit stated. (NIRF 2026 data: median INR 27 lakh for 219 placed graduates of 2024-25, all 2-yr PG programmes.)

selectionProcess.name: Entrance examination
selectionProcess.detail: Applicants must qualify the MAH-MBA/MMS CET (State CET Cell, Maharashtra); All India seats are filled per State CET Cell / DTE rules.

selectionProcess.name: Centralised Admission Process (CAP) by DTE / State CET Cell, Maharashtra
selectionProcess.detail: Seats are allotted on merit through CAP rounds (four CAP rounds in 2026-27); no institute-level GD/PI. Any vacant seat after CAP is filled through an Institutional (Counselling) Round on inter-se merit.

officialCutoffs.note: Closing percentile, CAP Round I, Maharashtra State seats, A.Y. 2026-27 (closing state merit no. 41). Published by State CET Cell, Maharashtra (CAP authority), not by JBIMS.

keyDates.notes: Admission is through MAH-MBA/MMS CET 2027 and Maharashtra CAP 2027-28; JBIMS has not published 2027 dates. For reference, 2026 CAP reporting at JBIMS ran 3 Aug (Round I) to 7 Sep 2026 (Round IV).

nirf.note: Not in NIRF 2025 Management ranks 1-100; 101-125 band not checked. NIRF ID from JBIMS's NIRF 2026 data submission hosted on jbims.edu.
